lab.docs.paragraph_0.text: GhostLab designs and publishes tools based on system contracts.

lab.docs.paragraph_1.text: Status: 8 October 2026 · GhostLab v1.0: available · v2.0: postponed until further notice

lab.docs.paragraph_3.text: Full workflow: Project → Template → Editor → Validate → Compile → Publisher → Googleplex. The system provides tool logic; the creator selects a template, configures the project and supplies its name and description.

lab.docs.paragraph_4.text: .lab projects: save, reopen, edit, validate, compile and publish. Projects also open from File Manager and the terminal.

lab.docs.paragraph_5.text: Six PvP families: System Log Reader, Security Panel Proxy, Financial Sniffer, Friend Kicker, Arsenal Cleaner and Intruder Kicker. Use requires Player Hack Access; custom tools follow their family rules and limits.

lab.docs.paragraph_6.text: Travel tickets, system maintenance, firmware and Deep Scanners — each template has its own requirements, targets and effects.

lab.docs.paragraph_7.text: PTK documents: Markdown editing with preview, global or clan publication, free and paid offers, and reading downloaded editions in Plexcak.

lab.docs.paragraph_8.text: Versioned publication, purchase, installation and explicit tool updates. Withdrawing an offer keeps players’ installed copies.

lab.docs.paragraph_9.text: AppForge, Term Creator, Window Maker and Button Choice create simpler operational applications. GhostLab builds tools using its template contracts.

lab.docs.paragraph_10.text: Research and Ghost Exchange — current scope

lab.docs.paragraph_11.text: Research currently provides the interface foundation, without an active research tree or unlocks. Ghost Exchange inside the lab is an information library, separate from the data package market in WebDragons. Future features are not yet available.

lab.docs.paragraph_12.text: In progress — Ghost System PL / EN

lab.docs.paragraph_13.text: Polish and English system interfaces, tool and ticket descriptions, service panels, messages and help share a language registry. Further languages, such as Russian and Spanish, can be added through approved language packs.

lab.docs.paragraph_14.text: The language migration is in progress. Player product names, descriptions, documents and other authored texts remain in their original language; the system does not translate them automatically.

lab.docs.paragraph_15.text: GhostLab v2.0 — postponed until further notice

lab.docs.paragraph_16.text: The following features remain development directions without a delivery date. Work on v2.0 is suspended; Ghost System localization does not depend on completing it.
